key.name: x
key.description: Horizontal position relative to the primary monitor. -1 centers the clock.

key.name: y
key.description: Vertical position relative to the primary monitor. -1 centers the clock.

key.name: show-seconds
key.description: Whether to draw the second hand.

key.name: show-timezone
key.description: Whether to draw the system time zone abbreviation.

key.name: above-windows
key.description: If true, the clock stays in front of all windows. If false, it stays just above the wallpaper.
